usedFor: TagMango holds orders and course progress, Memory keeps key-value records, and “Course Completion” can store a record through “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in TagMango, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: A new order is stored as key-value pairs you can look up later.

watchOut: “Delete Records” in Memory removes records, so check which records a TagMango event points at.
